description: One action to a genuinely verified receipt (POST /quickstart). Under your org it reuses-or-creates the project "TaScan Quickstart", its list "Quickstart" and the worker "Quickstart executor", adds a NEW task "Reply with the exact text: <expected>", completes it with your key, has the named policy quickstart_exact_output v1 compare the response to the expected text (verified or refuted, signed into the receipt), and publishes the receipt's public profile. expected defaults to "VERIFIED" (max 200 chars); response defaults to expected — pass a different response to see a refuted receipt. Returns the receipt URL and the public verify URL. Write tier.

expected.description: The exact text the task asks for (default "VERIFIED", max 200 chars).

response.description: The response to submit (default: the expected text). A different value is refuted.

name: tascan_quickstart
